image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate armor piece against a white background. The armor features a segmented, muscular design with embossed rectangular patterns on the lower half and smooth curved plates on the upper chest. It has a silver-grey metallic finish with visible highlights indicating a polished surface. Black attachment points or straps are visible on the sides.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black side straps appear slightly soft and lack crisp mechanical detail compared to the metal. There is minor blurring at the boundary between the metal and the white background on the lower right, suggesting slight edge bleeding.
The bottom edge of the breastplate fades out slightly rather than ending in a sharp, defined rim, which is common in AI generations of isolated objects.
